يكتروا (form VIII)
# يَكْتَرُوا (yaktarū) /jak.ta.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# يُكْتَرَوْا (yuktaraw) /juk.ta.raw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
